fusions.name: Fore and Hind
fusions.desc: Looses 2 kicks of force at once, splayed apart, each dealing 7 damage. Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Branching Buck
fusions.desc: Bucks a clod of earth into the first enemy in line, dealing 12 damage and knocking it back 2.5 tiles. It then forks to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 70% of the damage.

fusions.name: Take the Other Road
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and you move 20% faster for 5 seconds after.

fusions.name: Crossroads Sparks
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 6 damage, then forks to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Once every 5 seconds.
